messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool 'west-1-gpu-pool' saturation. avg_gpu_util=96%, queue_depth=186, 95p_latency=1200ms. Autoscaler attempted +8 nodes but hit scale_limit. Triggered at 2026-03-15T02:05:21Z. Paging oncall-mike and eng-infra.
oncall-mike: I'm on it. Acknowledge. Can someone confirm recent rollouts to west-1 in the last 4h? @anya_eng?
anya_eng: I rolled model v3.4 to weight 30% in west-1 @ 01:23 UTC for beta customers. It had a tokenizer/seq-change patch that unintentionally increased average sequence length for replies (we avoided changing API but internal tokenization tweak slipped). Seeing bigger KV cache per-session in dev logs earlier but didn't blow capacity there.
kevin_infra: Confirming autoscaler logs show it tried to spin up instances but hit gpu_pool.max_nodes=24 for that pool. Cloud quota for region is currently 24 GPUs. Attempted scale +8 at 02:06 but provider returned quota_error.
eva_prod: Customer impact: a subset of realtime customers (beta group ~12 orgs) report slow responses and rate-limited 429s. No total outages yet, but latency SLOs violated. CS getting DMs from two paying accounts.
oncall-mike: Ok plan — we need short-term mitigation and then remediation. Short term options: 1) Rollback v3.4 in west-1 to v3.3 2) Route heavy-context orgs to dedicated smaller model or different region 3) Increase autoscaler limit (needs quota request) 4) Apply emergency throttles.
anya_eng: I'm prepping a rollback PR now. Will post commands. If we rollback, we need to drain in-flight sessions gracefully so kv cache doesn't abruptly drop.
kevin_infra: Quota request will take 45-90m. Not quick enough. Suggest we apply routing rule to divert traffic with context_length>4096 to hosted-fallback model v3.3-small (less kv-footprint). We can implement a quick router filter in the edge rule set.
oncall-mike: Good. Can someone share how to identify heavy-context requests for routing? We need a quick filter, not full parsing.
anya_eng: We log "input_tokens" in request headers for telemetry; router can match on header 'x-input-tokens' > 4000. I'll update the router rule. Patch:
```
# edge-rule snippet
match: request.headers['x-input-tokens'] >= 4000
action: route -> model:v3.3-small
```
I can push in 2-3m.
kevin_infra: Pushing that rule now (edge-router). If it works we should reduce KV pressure immediately. Applying:
```
deply edge-router west-1 --apply-file=hotfix-route.yaml
```

(deploy bot): deploy started by kevin_infra for edge-router west-1
(deploy bot): deploy succeeded in 90s
kevin_infra: Edge rule in place. Monitoring queue depth.
oncall-mike: Observability? Any quick dashboard numbers? CPU/GPU util?
kevin_infra: Before rule: queue_depth=186, avg_kv_cache_size_per_gpu=2.1GB. After rule: queue_depth=186 -> 140 within 60s, avg_kv_cache_size_per_gpu -> 1.4GB. 95p latency down from 1200ms -> 760ms. Still high but trending.
eva_prod: Notifying affected customers: I'll DM the two paying accounts and say we're applying mitigations and may rollback if necessary. @lucy_sales can you prep comms for the other beta orgs?
lucy_sales: On it. Short note drafted. Will tag legal if any SLA risk.
anya_eng: Rollback PR to v3.3 created: merge/rollback-v3.4-west1. If edge filter stabilizes, we can merge after 10m of stability. Plan for graceful drain: set new rollout weight to 0 then wait for existing sessions to finish for 2m then decommission.
oncall-mike: Approve the rollback only if queue stops dropping or if we see a recurring spike. For now keep both mitigations: edge-route + prepare rollback.
kevin_infra: Another problem: autoscaler health-checks show repeated cold-start failures for additional instances due to model artifact prefetch time ballooning with v3.4's larger tokenizer state. That explains why we couldn't scale quickly. Prefetch logs:
```
[02:04:58] prefetch: model=v3.4 shard=3 size=1.2GB elapsed=19s
[02:05:06] prefetch: model=v3.4 shard=7 error=timeout prefetch_elapsed=31s
[02:05:10] instance-init: failed to join pool, reason=artifact_timeout
```
This is a hard cap on autoscale speed.
anya_eng: Ok that confirms root cause. v3.4's tokenization change increased shard metadata. Rollback is safest.
oncall-mike: Execute rollback now. Steps:
- anya merges rollback PR
- kevin sets rollout weight to 0 for v3.4 in west-1
- kevin monitors drain and then removes model artifacts
- eva continues comms

anya_eng: Merged rollback PR at 02:13:40 UTC. Patch sets rollout weights to v3.3=100% in west-1.
kevin_infra: Applying rollout change:
```
rctl rollout apply --region west-1 --model v3.3 --weight 100
```
(rctl): rollout job started job_id=jr-9921
kevin_infra: Weight change applied. Now monitoring session drain.
oncall-mike: Metrics update?
kevin_infra: queue_depth: 140 -> 78 over next 5m. avg_gpu_util: 96% -> 84%. 95p latency: 760ms -> 430ms. Prefetch failures stopped as new instances pull v3.3.
eva_prod: CS update sent to the two accounts. No escalations yet. I'm adding a postmortem note.
lucy_sales: Notifying rest of beta list: small apology + note about rollback and follow-up postmortem.
oncall-mike: Good. Next actions (owners):
- anya_eng: postmortem with root cause + regression test for tokenizer change (owner: anya) - due EOD
- kevin_infra: open quota request for west-1 GPU limit and document artifact prefetch timeout mitigation (owner: kevin) - due 48h
- platform: add pre-merge test that measures artifact prefetch size/time for model changes (owner: platform-team) - due next sprint
- eva_prod: coordinate customer follow-ups + draft status page blurb (owner: eva) - immediate

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to "mitigated" state at 2026-03-15T02:27:30Z. Duration: 22m. Severity: S2.
oncall-mike: Handoff to morning oncall (UTC+0) for follow-up. I'll prepare timeline and drop into postmortem thread. If anything regresses reopen page. :white_check_mark:
anya_eng: Will run a local reproduce for tokenizer patches and add a unit that fails if avg_output_seq_length increases >5% vs baseline.
eva_prod: I'll update the affected customer tickets with timeline and next steps. Thanks team.
